blocked_user_ids.hint: Blocks content commands in private chats and all groups. Empty blocks nobody. Help and version remain available.

blocked_group_ids.hint: Blocks content commands for everyone in these groups. Empty blocks no groups. Help and version remain available.

max_pending_per_user.description: Running plus queued tasks per user

timeout_seconds.description: Task timeout in seconds, including upload, excluding queue wait

max_retries.hint: Metadata retries apply per upstream domain; task timeout still bounds the whole task.

max_download_mib.description: Cumulative image response bytes per task (MiB)
max_download_mib.hint: Includes bytes received during failed attempts; metadata is not counted.

max_archive_mib.hint: A local limit, not a guarantee that QQ accepts files of this size.

proxy_url.hint: Leave empty for direct connections. Do not commit credentials.

api_domains.hint: Without https:// or paths. Empty uses the library defaults.
